reviews.text: Cooper loves this place!  Friendly, attentive staff.  Clean, maintained location.  So happy we found Underdog!  Our only choice for daycare, boarding or training needs.  Rest assured your pets are in great, caring hands.

we have been boarding our dogs at Underdog for over a year. It is obvious they enjoy their time there as they nearly jump out of the car & race to the door. We appreciate Underdog’s communication and photos during their stay. Highly recommend Underdog Kennels.
Melissa, thanks for your 5 STAR REVIEW!  Buddy is a joy to be around - everyone is excited when he comes to visit.  Thanks for sharing him with us!
Melissa, thanks for your 5 STAR Review!  We're glad we met your expectations.  If there is ever anything we can do to make your pups visit more enjoyable, please do not hesitate to ask.

Had my two pups come in for the first time. In the morning dropping them off I was told they would be in the VIP rooms and I agreed on that. Hours later I call and am told they were in a big room. I assumed it was the same thing. when I go to pick them up I'm given a tour of the facility to which is just a warehouse with no ac. My dogs have heart conditions and cannot stay in hot rooms I had let them know about this before I dropped them off. Was never told by staff this could be an issue. I was shown the VIP rooms but did not see my dogs in any of them. She then showed me a standard small "room" smaller than what you would find at a shelter. She then told me that my dogs were in a bigger "room" that looked similar. I was told to wait in the lobby for them. I did not have a good feeling at this point and ended up going to the back to see where my dogs were staying. They were in the same small room I was shown before. Two dogs in that small "room" with no ac yet they provide ac in the lobby. Then I was told my dogs did not eat breakfast but by now it was 6 pm I had dropped them off at 8:30am. They had food still that hadn't been open. They didn't even try to feed them all day. Once in my car they were starving and ate all their food. Please do not bring your dogs here. There are better facilities out there.

I can't say enough good things about Underdog Kennels. I've been afraid to do any type of daycare because my dog is usually reactive, but they handled him so well and in no time he was playing with all the other dogs.

I am so impressed with Underdog Kennels and staff!  Today was Sadie’s second visit and I could tell from the pictures that she was having fun.  You can also see from the pictures what a clean and safe environment it is.  The staff members who greet you could not be nicer and it’s obvious they really care about your pets.  Exceptional!
Great boarding facility. My dog loves it

My three dogs love going to doggie daycare at Underdog Kennels!  I take them once a week so they can play with the other dogs and socialize with people besides myself.  The staff come out to the car and walk the dogs into the facility, a huge benefit since I'm a senior citizen and could not possibly get 3 large, excited dogs safely out of the car and into the building by myself.  These are the reasons I chose Underdog Kennels and will continue to take my 3 rescue dogs there. They love it!!

I was nervous about taking my dog to a new place but they put my mind at ease when they came out to get Sasha for her first meet and greet. They were very welcoming to me and sweet to my dog Sasha and I loved that they immediately took her for a walk in their walking yard and they showed me around the facility and it was neat and organized. They answered all my questions and they took pictures of Sasha during both of her playtimes and they texted me a link to their Facebook page showing me pictures of Sasha within only 2-3 hours of dropping her off. When I picked her up they told me how much they liked Sasha and how sweet she is. They even gave me a report card which told me she made a new friend that she really liked to play with. They answered more questions before I left and told me the dogs not only get a walk in the morning then 2 playtimes, but also 2 more walks! They have 3-4 people in the play yard at all times to give your dog attention and for safety. We will definitely be back for more daycare and also boarding. I love that they take the time and have the staff to give dogs the full attention and care that they deserve. Thank you so much Underdog!!
Very well run caring safe place for my puppy!!!
Sully had his first day of doggie daycare and I could tell when I picked him up that he absolutely loved his time there! He was so happy! Can’t wait to bring him back!

Billy loved daycare and didn’t want to leave. I thought he would jump into the car, but instead we had to lift him up to get him in.
I’m sure we will be back.
He was so worn out, and thanks for keeping him so busy.
He’s coming back for boarding this weekend.
Thanks for everything ❤️❤️

Lisette, thank you for trusting us with your curly cuties!  Joy and Paris have always been great guests.  I can't help but smile when I see them.  If there is ever anything we can do to make their stay more enjoyable, please don't hesitate to ask.

Our dog LOVES his time with Underdog Kennel!
Runs in when we drop him off.
We wouldn’t board him anywhere else!
BEST PLACE IN DALLAS FOR YOUR DOG, THEY ARE VERY PROFESSIONAL, EXCELLENT PEOPLE AND NICE PLACE FOR YOUR PUPPY OF ANY AGE.

Spoke with the owner Rob, and he was very nice, polite and professional; he booked Dash’s first visit. My 4 month old puppy loved his visit! The staff was friendly and greeted us with open arms! He was a little nervous at drop off; however at pick up time,  he came home happy, confident w/a “big boy swag”. 💙😊
I’m comfortable with leaving him for our upcoming trip. We have officially found our new daycare and boarding for Dash. Thank you so very much Underdog Kennels!

Underdog Kennels is undoubtedly the most sophisticated upscale place to leave your fur baby while on vacation or if you’re just needing a daycare adventure for your dog. I am a repeat customer.  I’ve only used the boarding service so far but definitely will consider day care sometime. They incredibly personalized my dogs stay. I have used them several times for short vacations to a more lengthy recent stay. I have friend who have been on extended weeks vacations and trusted them with their dog. They do an amazing job! I trust them totally with the meds, feeding and  playtime and the best is they post at least twice a day pictures on their FB group page of playtime and your dog interacting. This is great to help with my own anxiety about leaving her in a strange place to see how she is adapting. She has had no issues when coming back home except to sleep a lot at first just to relax and unwind…..I definitely will use them again. They have other services too like training etc…. even nail clipping! They get a A+++ in my books!

If I could rate it 10 stars I would. As an anxious dog mom they really made me feel at ease & that my baby was going to be safe and sound. We cannot recommend this place enough so excited for the McKinney facility to open.

I had to leave town for a work trip & as a reactive/rescue  dog-mom I was really worried how this would trun out. They were very patient with all my questions and explained everything to me when i first called, which was really reassuring. My reservation was also very short notice and while making sure about the safety of my dog & every other beloved staying there, they were very cooperative in handling things on his trial time. I still felt a bit anxious once i left him but very soon after they sent me photos of him playing happily which was a relief & very nice surprise considering his usuall reactivity outside.
They remained responsive and reassuring throughout the whole week he was there, & watching his happy photos playing & having a good time became a pleasent part of my day during my trip; (kudos to the photographer who catches moments beautifully),
After I picked him up a few items of him were left there but they contacted me and even kindly dropped them to my address.
I deeply appreciate every single act of kindness towards dogs (& animals in general) & it felt so nice that this place is full of kind & considerate people.
My only suggestion would be adding few daily photos of them in their nap/rest time as well (if possible) which would melt every dog-mom's heart 🫠☺️
overall, great experience ✌️🙏🏻🐶

Im so relieved to find a trustworthy daycare to keep my boi at!!! The dogs all have lots of lovin and playin and they take lots of pics so you can see em havin fun. My Bowser came home happy and tired lol
David, thanks for your FIVE STAR REVIEW!
Best boarding service I ever experienced. I love how they take care of the pups and allow them play time with other dogs. Best of all, booking online is easy and payable in advance.

Best dog boarding in the DFW area!! My dogs always have a blast when they get to stay at Underdog Kennels. We love getting to see them playing in all of the daily Facebook pictures they post, and they always look so happy. Underdog hires only the best employees who are true animal lovers, and they take the absolute best care of your dog.

We left Bruce in good hands. It was his first overnight stay. I was impressed they wanted to do a whole day trial. I liked the photos so you know they are getting play time and fresh air. Overall, excellent service and staff know what they are doing ! Great response via email and phone !
They truly love my dogs.  They took amazing care of my dog in a life or death situation that arose through no fault of theirs.
A great staff that provides a personal level of care.

This is the only place I trust for doggy daycare and overnight boarding. I met the owners and the staff members and they are all passionate about dogs and truly care about what they do. The facilities are clean, well organized, and they are very strict with vaccination schedules. They’re also located so close to both airports!

We have been a loyal client of Underdog for 4 years and LOVE their VIP Rooms for dogs — they even do “room service” and private play time add-ons! They play Animal Planet for them and the rooms are furnished with real beds and decorated with fun themes (Princess, superheroes, etc.). Our dog requires daily medication and I can always trust Underdog to administer them.

If you’re looking for a place where your dog will look visibly excited to enter so you can have a worrisome vacation or work day, this is the place. They are pricey, but worth it to not worry about whether your dog will be safe and be comfortable.

Kudos to Rob, Nikki, Maria, Morgan and the team at UDK for running the best doggy daycare in DFW!

I LOVE this place!! This is the third daycare I have tried in the Dallas area and Underdog Kennels is by far my favorite (one of the other daycare centers forgot to feed my dog!!). Underdog Kennels is well run and managed. You can easily tell the staff takes such good care of each pup! My mini golden retriever, Tomato, loves it! Pick up and drop off is so easy. I love the photo updates on facebook.  The best thing is that I'm done with my daycare search because I have found Tomato's second home!! And with the first visit free?! You can't go wrong. I actually also love that they plan and have structured nap times. THe others I tried wiped my pup out and he would sleep straight through the evening to then not sleep throughout the night because he slept straight from 6-10pm. At underdog kennels, my pup is still awake and is back to his regular sleep times! LOVE that!
It must be nice to have a good business knowing that your General Contractors are not paying small subcontractors for the services so that your locations are finished soon

5/5 Stars – Underdog Kennels is the ONLY place we trust with our pups!
We've been taking our dogs, Abby and Herb to Underdog Kennels for daycare and occasional boarding for 4 years now, and I can't say enough good things. They absolutely love it here—they get so excited every single time we pull up to the facility, tail wagging like crazy as soon as they recognize the place!
The staff knows them by name and truly seems to love their jobs. They take such great care of him—playtime, attention, the works. Herb has some anxiety, especially when the group has to play indoors due to weather, so they proactively moved him to VIP play (individual supervised sessions) to keep him comfortable and stress-free. That kind of thoughtful, personalized attention means the world to us.
We usually have a trusted pet sitter for overnights, but if she's not available, Underdog Kennels is the only place we'll board our pups. No question. They come home happy, tired, and clearly well-loved. It's a relief knowing they're in such caring hands.
Highly recommend—whether for daycare or boarding, Underdog treats every dog like family. Thank you to the amazing team!

Underdog Kennels is the only place we consider for our dog! The staff is amazing, so thoughtful and responsive, and we truly appreciate how much they love our dog for us when we’re away! We highly recommend Underdog Kennels!!
My dog loves this place so much. I really love the FB photos of the dogs playing and how kind all the staff people are to dogs! Don't hesitate to book your dog for this place!

Calvin loves going to daycare and overnight stays at Underdog! The staff are lovely and I appreciate the in-app booking and quick responsiveness even when it’s last minute/same day.
I also appreciate the care taken to socialize him with other like-maturity & sized pups!
The photos on FB of him having fun with his pup-buddies are a bonus!
Super-friendly, caring, and loving staff. It doesn't get any better than Underdog kennels.
Everyone was extremely sweet with our pups and they seemed to have a wonderful time.
My pups Ronan and Petey loved it here. They had so much fun and they were able to get a lot of energy out. I will definitely bring them back to Underdog!

The staff is outstanding, and the service is equally exceptional. By just the second day, the excitement and joy my puppy showed walking through the doors assured me that I chose the perfect doggy daycare. They also provided photos of him on his first day through their Facebook page.

My Aussie and I love Underdog! The employees are so friendly and know all the dogs’ names. The photos posted throughout the day are so fun. I have boarded and used daycare here and cannot recommend more.

Our dog, Kaya, seemed to love Underdog Kennels. I mean, she can’t exactly sit us down for a post-stay debrief, but judging by how unimpressed she was to see us when we picked her up, we’re pretty sure she had a great time. The staff kept the Facebook page updated (especially if you spring for private playtime), and she came back healthy—which is a huge win, since our past kennel experiences usually ended with a sick pup. First round here: no issues at all. We’ve already booked her spot for holiday travel.

The team is friendly, patient, and quick to answer questions. A little detail we really appreciate: they handle pick-up and drop-off right from your car. It saves you from the chaos of an overexcited dog stampede in the waiting area.

My puppy absolutely loves going to Underdog!! From the moment we park, one of the friendly staff members comes out to get him. They always remember my dog’s name and they seem just as excited to see my pup as he is to see them. They post pics on their facebook page at playtime so you can stay up to date with what your dog is doing. The staff members actually play with your dogs and it seems that they have a total blast. My dog is very sociable so he loves swimming and play time with all his new friends. Highly recommend!! The best!!

*UPDATE*
My dog has been going to Underdog weekly, for months now and he is so excited every time we pull into the parking lot. He’s made so many friends and the staff has become his second family. It feels good knowing my pup is well taken care of and safe, while still having the time of his life. They even gave him a birthday party on his birthday. I cannot say enough amazing things about the staff. They treat the pups so well and seem to really love their job. Underdog is the best!!

We have used UnderDog for the last 5 years and they are without a doubt the BEST!!! They always take great care of our big boy Snyder and post photos daily of him playing with his fellow big dog friends. He is a rescue so we really wanted to find a place that makes him feel welcome and enjoys and when we drop him off he walks right in and doesn’t look back. The staff is always very friend and welcoming and will alert you if anything seems off with your pup while you’re gone. 10/10 recommend
Raleigh had a fabulous time boarding at Underdog. All smiles during his visit!
Fantastic experience! My dog loves Underdog and all the wonderful staff! He is a frequent guest there and I never worry about his care. He is well taken care of and loved by everyone!
Mayra, thanks for your 5 STAR REVIEW!

Really friendly staff. My Jaxon loves it here and he seems to be adjusting very well with making friends. They definitely have come in hand while we are in the mist of transitioning and it allows for my fur baby to get more socializing in. I definitely give them a 5 star and I would definitely recommend them especially if you’re new to the area. Jaxon will see you guys soon. His bday is coming up 8/19
Spacious place and super friendly staff.

Hello, I am very grateful for the care my furry friends received and for their report card. This way I can help my dogs with their anxiety; it was their first time. I hope they will be calmer next time.

Underdog has the kindest employees who truly make your pup feel loved.  They have taken exceptional care of our FiFi over the years. They are her 2nd family. Such an incredible business that we will truly miss when we move. Thanks, Underdog Team!
My dog Lucy loves Underdog Kennels! She gets so excited every time one of the staff members picks her up from my car! They provide pools on hot days which is great for my water loving dog!

My pup Harley (9mts Chihuahua) had a great time on his first day at Underdog was returned to me happy and tired loved the posted pictures on Facebook. But felt like they were set up not current play. Would like live cameras to check in when I would like to see pups playing and staff interaction. The only thing I was confused about I received a report card for the 1st day but no instructions on what is next no price structure no offer of setting up program. When going on line the links for pricing and programs go nowhere. Was very happy with the love and care of my pup received, and am happy to have found a nice clean place for my pup to socialize and play

We’re SO happy we found our pups’ new favorite hangout —Underdog Kennels for our rescued pups Kai & Yuzu! 🐶🎉 Just 2 miles from our home and already obsessed! 🐾❤️

The staff is amazing — they updated me with texts, posted the cutest photos of our pups playing, AND even gave us report cards for each of them! 📸🐶

Kai (our social therapy pup) made tons of new friends in the “Bigs” group and Yuzu was her shy self, following her big brother everywhere. 🐕💕

They came home happy, exhausted, and ready for a good nap — no extra walks for us tonight! 🙌💤

Huge thanks to Underdog Kennels — can’t wait to send them back for more fun (and naps for us)! 🐕❤️
It had been a long time since we boarded our dog and they were very caring about her stay. Making sure she wasn’t too stressed out and keeping an eye on her.

Great experience with underdog kennels! Staff was professional & helpful with my puppy. Made me feel comfortable at drop off. Loved getting the updates & photos from her play time with the other tween pups! Looking forward to going back for day care and possibly boarding soon! Thank you for the great hospitality and kindness to my puppy Scarlett. She had a great time!!

They are super accommodating and have very nice accommodations for pets. Only thing I would like to see different is live feeds to watch your dog and have a code to watch while your dog is staying. They do post photos on their web site, but the live feed is super nice at other locations.
Cloe had a great time—-she wants to do it again and we will make sure she gets to do that.
Jack spent a wonderful day playing with other puppies and staff. They make everything so much fun for our four legged friends! Highly recommend!

Had a not so great experience at a different daycare recently which made me incredibly apprehensive. All those apprehensions disappeared as I walked through the door. The staff was incredibly communicative, kind and caring. I also love that I was texted a status on how Houston was doing as well as being able to view his playtimes through the Facebook posts. Knowing that my pup is not just fine but thriving, truly puts my mind at ease and that is priceless. I can’t thank the place enough for this. Houston (my pup) and I have fallen in love with the place!
Mary, thanks for your FIVE STAR review!  We really appreciate it :)
Happy has been coming here for over three years. I know she's in the best care rather it's for the day to play with her friends or 10 days while I'm on vacation. We love it at Underdog Kennels 🐾💞 …
We’ve always had a positive experience and our dogs seem to leave there very happy. Highly recommend! Not inexpensive but worth the extra for good care and extra perks.

Update 4/2015: Our dog continues to love Underdog Kennels. The staff are so good with her and she is always excited when we take her. We often board her overnight here and we know that she is being well taken care of. The whole team really seem to love their jobs and we are always happy to see that they are excited when we bring our dog. Great place!

We brought our puppy for her first day of daycare and she had a blast! The staff were super friendly and the facility is very nice. We definitely will be going back.

I was nervous about leaving my two dogs there. I had never boarded my dogs before. The staff was very friendly and set me at ease. Both my dogs seem to enjoy it. Very much. Plan to use them in the future.

Love Underdog Kennels!! Had our first experience with them and my pup today and the staff was so attentive and communicative. We love the VIP options and extra special snacks they provide, just taking everything to the next level. Highly recommend from this dog Momma! Thank you!

Our lab Riley absolutely loves going to Underdog Kennels! She is all smiles and gets so excited to go for doggy day care! She always looks like she’s smiling and being loved on by the staff in the pictures they post while she’s there! We recommend to all of our Dallas friends with dogs!

So happy to have found this place. My fur baby Dallas did not want to go to daycare anymore until I started bringing her here.  She loves it now!  Great communication and friendly staff and the Facebook pictures they post throughout the day is a great bonus. I'm able to see her smile while I'm work and know she is well taken care of during the day.
I was met in the parking lot to assist bringing in my dogs and they helped me when we were leaving. I was given a report card of their stay and saw multiple photos of them on the Facebook page.
Our dog Max loves this place! They post great pictures and are super friendly!
Kiersten, thanks for your 5 STAR Review!

Their services are unmatched! I specifically take my dog here for their VIP (very important pup) service that allows dogs to individually play with the staff due to their behaviors around other dogs. For the first visit, they offer it for free to see if their boarding facility is the right place for your pup. I appreciated the 'report card' they give out during that visit as it provides positive feedback for their behaviors. Every visit, my dog Peluchin seems to enjoy their care! He seems loved and cared for by every staff member he interacts with. I enjoy the constant picture updates on their page, even if my dog is on the shy side!! Shoutout to their front desk team, always a delight interacting with them.

Our dog Oakley absolutely loves going to Underdog Kennels twice a week for daycare and playtime! He gets excited when he sees the friendly staff members who come out to the car to take him inside, and we can tell how much fun he’s having throughout the day by viewing the fun playtime pics that the staff posts on Facebook. We have also boarded him there a few times, and as someone who was never comfortable boarding any of my previous dogs, I am so grateful that our boy adjusted so well to his stays at UK thanks to the excellent staff and the care he receives from them. UK is definitely his home away from home!
Emily, thanks for your 5 STAR review!

Thank you guys for loving on my baby, Heaven. Looking at the photos you shared from FB, you can see the excitement on my baby girls face. If you guys are looking for a daycare for your furbaby, I highly recommend Underdog Kennel.
Mark, thanks for your 5 STAR Review!
Easy to work with and our pup loves it there!

Very happy to have found this place! Riley always has a good time and is worn out when I pick her up. I have left her for Daycare and Overnight stay and have nothing but good things to say about them. All the pictures they post is always a plus!
I HAD PNEUMONIA , HAD TO BE HOSPITAL FOR NIGHTS, ROB CLEARED ME TO LEAVE "CHOSEN" WITHEN THE HOUR, DROP HER ON THE WAY. "THE BEST OBOVE THE REST" THANKS KEN
Maarten, thanks for your 5 Star Review!
They take such good care of my dog Leo when I was away for two weeks. Being a 1 year old husky he’s a lot of energy and it’s great to know he’s in good hands when I’m away.
